purpose: remove finite-sample-size distortion from cross-cancer comparison of Stage A1 static network coordinates without changing the Stage A1 definitions
trigger: Stage A1 audit found modest negative association between cohort size and raw absolute-correlation coordinates; this is a construction effect that must be controlled before biological comparison across cancers

calibration.sampling: deterministic random subsamples without replacement within cancer
calibration.summary: for each cancer-module-metric report median and 5th/95th percentile across fixed-n resamples
calibration.interpretation: fixed-n summaries are development calibration coordinates only; they are not p-values or evidence of criticality

topology_diagnostics.within_cancer_module_ranks: use Spearman relationships across the 50 modules because cohort n is constant within each cancer
primary_relationships: Stage A0 variability vs Stage A1 network coordinates
